name: Compliance Dashboard
description: Regulatory compliance and audit trail monitoring

nrql.query: SELECT average(policyComplianceScore) FROM PolicyComplianceScore SINCE 15 minutes ago
SELECT count(*) FROM AuditEvent TIMESERIES 15 minutes SINCE 6 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM ComplianceViolationEvent SINCE 1 hour ago
SELECT count(*) FROM DataAccessEvent SINCE 1 hour ago
SELECT count(*) FROM ComplianceViolationEvent FACET standard SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM AuditEvent FACET eventType SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM DataAccessEvent FACET sensitivity SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(policyComplianceScore) FROM PolicyComplianceScore FACET department SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM AuditEvent FACET userRole SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT standard, violationType, severity, department, remediationStatus, timestamp FROM ComplianceViolationEvent ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 15
SELECT average(policyComplianceScore) FROM PolicyComplianceScore FACET policyName TIMESERIES 1 hour SINCE 24 hours ago

SELECT dataType, accessType, userRole, count(*) FROM DataAccessEvent WHERE sensitivity = 
\high' SINCE 24 hours ago ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT eventType, resourceType, userRole, count(*) FROM AuditEvent WHERE actionResult != \success' SINCE 24 hours ago ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 10
